scope: Draft presentation/demo package only; no actual narration generation, video encoding or native validation

focused_preflight_tests.scope: Metadata and text fixtures, with probe function stubbed; CLI missing-input refusal tested using actual template
verified_refusals: stale source and illustration in native slot
insufficient native duration or excessive narration duration
speech over ambient passage or duration at three minutes
missing inputs before creation of output directory
mismatched installed package or missing/changed/inconsistent hashed capture receipt
long container or alternate video stream concealing a short first mapped video stream
long container or alternate audio stream concealing a short first mapped app-audio stream
unknown, nonfinite or nonpositive mapped-stream coverage
selected source interval extending past either mapped native stream
shorter duration_ts/time_base coverage despite a longer duration field
verified_valid_cases: complete source-bound metadata with known zero starts and sufficient first-stream durations
exact duration_ts/time_base coverage with start_pts equal to zero
selected interval ending exactly at both native stream coverage boundaries
focused_preflight_tests.stream_coverage_policy: Use the first video and first audio streams that the renderer maps. Require finite positive stream duration or exact duration_ts/time_base coverage, taking the shorter bound when both are present. Container duration and later streams never establish coverage. Native video and any mapped native audio must cover source_start plus the entire selected interval. Narration uses first-audio duration. Every timed mapped stream must have a known zero start_time or exact start_pts/time_base origin; nonzero and unknown origins are rejected because offset normalization is unsupported.
